scope: NON-SCIENTIFIC qualification of the signed order-3 error algebra (DESIGN.md sections 3-4) on manufactured analytic systems with exact derivatives. It does not run, build or qualify the Arb producer; touches no CUSUM or SR operator, cell table, K1 record, closure export or host; computes no R''' of any (D,m); is not a K5 probe; authorizes nothing.
execution_rule: Unit tests (tests/test_order3_algebra.py) use disjoint seeds and were run during development. The trials below are first executed only after the commit that freezes this file and the bound code. Any code change after that commit invalidates this protocol; a repair needs a new protocol revision, and r1 evidence stays as recorded.

assembly_table.note: read for the coefficient table only; it is the frozen K1 checkpoint config, not a result

QN1_SOUNDNESS.criterion: PASS iff, on every trial with no mutation, zero containment violations: (a) every object F_r and W_(r,j), orders 0-3, midpoint error <= eps_mid; (b) at 17 equispaced exact grid points of the cell including both endpoints, every object error <= eps_cell; (c) for every m in {1,2,3,5} and order 0-3, the true assembled value lies in the midpoint interval at e0 and in the cell interval at every grid point; (d) the signed export L <= R'''_m(e) <= U at e0 and at every grid point
QN1_SOUNDNESS.note: (b)-(d) sample the cell exactly at 17 points; they are a necessary-condition check of the whole-cell rules, not a proof. The proof is DESIGN.md section 3.

QN2_MUTATION_SENSITIVITY.criterion: PASS iff each required mutation produces >= 1 containment violation on its designated trial AND that trial has zero violations unmutated

trials.why: H alone is wrong; D, F exact; the order-3 rung is re-solved exactly, so its whole error is 3 K_1 (Hhat-H)/(1-K_0) and the norm constants are attained to O(rho)
K_1(e0) = K_2(e0) = 0, so D and H stay exact and the order-3 error is K_3 (Fhat-F)/(1-K_0); without the k_3 eps_F term the bound is O(rho^2)
exact candidates: every midpoint error is 0, so any rule that forgets the cell width, flips the lower bound, or mis-assembles is visible against the exact values

QN3_EXACT_ARITHMETIC.criterion: PASS iff code/order3_algebra.py and code/manufactured.py contain no float literal and no float() call (AST)

QN4_SCIENTIFIC_FENCE.criterion: PASS iff the three bound code files import only the stdlib whitelist plus each other, and reference no cell table, K1 record tree, closure export, runtime root, CUSUM kernel module, numerical backend, network or subprocess (AST imports + forbidden-substring scan)

QN5_FROZEN_ASSEMBLY_TABLE.criterion: PASS iff the pinned checkpoint.json hash matches and the reference coefficient rule equals its assembly table for m in {1,2,3,5}

QN6_DETERMINISM.criterion: PASS iff `qualify_nonscientific.py check` replays the run in a fresh process and the evidence bytes are identical

overall: NONSCIENTIFIC_QUALIFICATION = PASS iff QN1-QN6 all PASS. Even on PASS: PRODUCER_SCIENTIFICALLY_QUALIFIED = NO and K5_PROBE_AUTHORIZED = NO.
prohibited: running any order-3 computation on any frozen K1 cell (SR or CUSUM), including far-field cells
reading any K1 record, closure export or runtime root
executing the frozen K5 feasibility oracle or any K5 probe
